quality.notes: rewrite_compose_statements collects resolve_alias_statement results and calls expect, while resolve_alias_qualified_name returns Err for an unknown binder type namespace. A common-init ForAll or expression binder with an undeclared alias can therefore panic instead of propagating CoreError from lower_compose.

rewrite_lvalue does receive the bound set, contrary to the rationale, and deliberately applies it only while rewriting an index expression; every lvalue base is handled by rewrite_state_name. This is consistent with assignment targets being component state while ForAll binders are read-only expression names, so the claimed local write is not supported by this code.

ComponentNames::collect classifies Until and Unless alongside other named properties, but rewrite_component_item returns those variants unchanged while prefixing and rewriting Invariant, Trans, Reachable, and LeadsTo. Thus component-local names and references in Until/Unless can escape the alias rewrite and plausibly collide or become unresolved.
